# Matrix Launcher release reference

The manual updater reads the latest stable GitHub Release in `bitmere/matrix-launcher`. It checks the terminal Android version-code line, the APK size, the release-notes SHA-256 (with sidecar fallback), and the package, version and bitmere signer before installation.

The current source version is 2.7.14 (Android versionCode 163). Clean install is only required when upgrading from pre-2.7.6 builds; 2.7.6+ releases update in place. See the [AI handover index](../llms.txt) and [detailed technical reference](llms-full.txt).
